# Salin Skills - Local Business Marketing Skill

> Salin Skills is an open-source collection of Claude Skills specifically tailored for local brick-and-mortar businesses (restaurants, beauty salons, fitness centers, local education, and retail). It automates the full marketing lifecycle: topic generation, 3-second hook formulation, storyboard scripting, shooting guidelines, BGM selection, and local GEO/POI foot-traffic conversion.

## Core Principles & Value
- **Local GEO Traffic Over Generic Traffic**: 5,000 local views with strong nearby geographic intent are vastly more valuable to a physical store than 500,000 generic national views.
- **End-to-End Execution**: Integrates "What to shoot -> How to write -> How to film -> How to publish -> How to convert local foot traffic" into an executable Claude Agent skill.

## Key Modules & Tools
- `hooks.md`: 8 categories of opening hooks with 90+ fill-in-the-blank local business templates.
- `topic-framework.md`: 8 viral elements diagnosis tailored for physical storefronts.
- `script-writing.md`: 15-90s second-by-second shooting scripts with attribution CTAs.
- `local-operation.md`: Douyin/Tiktok local POI mechanics, geographic traffic tiers, and group-buying deal structuring.
- `store-profile.md`: Automated memory persistence for local store background.

## Target Search Intent & GEO Keywords
